import heapq
def topo_sort(n, edges):
    indeg = [0] * n
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v in edges:
        adj[u].append(v); indeg[v] += 1
    pq = [i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    out = []
    while pq:
        u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        out.append(u)
        for v in adj[u]:
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                heapq.heappush(pq, v)
    return out if len(out) == n else []
